questions.q:
Identify the segment in the sentence that contains a grammatical error.

We'll need to gather farther information about the project's scope and requirements before we can make a detailed plan and provide an accurate estimate.
o: about the project's scope and requirements before
we can make a detailed plan and provide an accurate estimate
We'll need to gather farther information
questions.s:
The correct answer is '​We'll need to gather farther information'.

Key Points

  • The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
  • Here, '​We'll need to gather further information' should be used instead of '​We'll need to gather farther information'.
  • "Further" is used to refer to a greater degree or extent, especially in the context of abstract things like information, progress, or understanding. It suggests going to a greater depth, degree, or extent.
  • "Farther" is typically used to refer to physical distance or location, implying a greater physical separation.
  • In the sentence, you are talking about the need for additional or more in-depth information, which aligns with the abstract concept of "further information." "Farther information" would suggest a greater physical distance or location, which is not what you're trying to convey in this context. So, "further" is the appropriate word to use when discussing the need for more detailed or extensive information. 
     

Correct Sentence: We'll need to gather further information about the project's scope and requirements before we can make a detailed plan and provide an accurate estimate.

questions.q:
In the following question, one part of the sentence may have an error. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option.

Ever since Justin made the (A)/ revelation, fans have been (B)/ impatiently waiting for him to (C)/ release the better version of the game. (D)
questions.s:
Part D has an error.

The article 'the' is used only before the superlative degree and not before the

positive or comparative degree. So, 'the better' should be replaced with 'a better' to rectify the given sentence.

Hence, option (c) is the correct answer.

The correct sentence is: Ever since Justin made the revelation, fans have been impatiently waiting for him to release a better version of the game.
